name: Nagaretsuki, Shima
source:
Main character loses consciousnesses and gets dragged into the sea. He awakens at an island inhabited only by girls. Some invisible force prevents all attempts to get out of this place. Protagonist is doomed to build relations with these girls for the time being.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公失去意识后被卷入海中，醒来时已经身处一座只有女孩居住的岛屿。某种无形力量阻止所有人离开这里。暂时无法脱身的主人公，只得与岛上的女孩们建立关系。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
